title: Getting Started With Agents: Agent Access Control - Permissions and Profiles (2025)

chapters.title: Using Agent Log Entries for Troubleshooting

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An AI-powered agent designed to perform sales order tasks while keeping users informed about key steps. It interacts with Business Central functionality similar to how users do, using UI elements to determine required steps.
caveats: Requires proper permissions and profiles to access specific controls

features.name: Agent Profile Customization
features.description: Agents come with a pre-built profile out of the box that can be customized to add or remove pages, actions, and other controls as needed. Administrators can verify exactly which pages and controls the agent can access by switching to the assigned profile.
caveats: Customization requires disabling agent before making changes

features.name: Agent Permission Sets
features.description: The sales order agent comes with a pre-built permission set to help users get started quickly. Administrators can review which permissions are included and modify them as needed.
caveats: Custom apps or customizations may require additional permissions not in the pre-built set
Agents may encounter permission errors if they lack necessary permissions for extended processes

features.name: Agent Log Entries
features.description: A troubleshooting tool that gives a complete overview of the steps the agent performed while working on a task, including the pages it navigated to, the actions it invoked, and any issues it encountered.
caveats: Requires agent to be disabled before adding required permissions to fix issues

features.name: Agent User Management
features.description: Administrators can add additional users who should have access to the agent pane where they can review and approve agent steps. Administrators can grant or revoke the ability to manage agent configuration.
